Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
Roughly how much does it cost?

Treatment fees depend on the type of treatment and your condition. You can find pricing information on our website, and our staff can explain the details during your visit. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
I'm sorry, I can't give exact figures for treatment costs. I can pass your details to our staff so they can get back to you with the information. May I have your name, please?
